anomalyzone.emission.warning_subtitle: §7🔊 «Alert! Scavengers, attention! An emission is approaching!»
anomalyzone.quest.desc.boar_hunt.0: Hey, scavenger. The boars in the Red Forest have gone wild, roaming in packs - can't even get near the trails. Take down %s of them, we'll settle up.
Big order, scavenger. Red Forest - %s boars, period. Take it and I'll make you rich, as long as you're not greedy.
A rare request for a real scavenger: %s finds from zombie houses, any of the three kinds. Reward for this kind of work is top tier.
gui.anomalyzone.pda.contacts.ambient.des: Background scavengers around Valhalla. Some of them hand out short jobs - hunting boars, placing psi emitters or clearing a zombified stash.
item.anomalyzone.legend_zone_blueprint.t: The schematics describe the legendary container of veteran scavengers.
advancements.anomalyzone.zone.bolt.descr: Get a bolt, a scavenger's best friend
gui.anomalyzone.pda.hb.section.enemies.d: Zombified, scavengers, traders and how they behave.
gui.anomalyzone.pda.hb.start.hour.contac: The buyer takes your artifacts and junk for rubles, the seller offers gear and supplies, the barterer builds sets from blueprints and materials. Higher reputation means better buying prices and a wider selection. Scavengers wander near Valhalla - some of them hand out short tasks.
gui.anomalyzone.pda.hb.start.check.4.des: A contract arrives on the PDA: Accept or Decline. Scavengers near Valhalla hand out short tasks.
gui.anomalyzone.pda.hb.start.pda.intro: The PDA is the scavenger's main tool: tasks, artifacts, reputation, contacts and this handbook.
gui.anomalyzone.pda.hb.start.pda.tab.que: Quest - PDA contracts and tasks from traders and scavengers.
gui.anomalyzone.pda.hb.x.trade_who.quest: Scavengers and the contractor hand out quests and contracts — see the Quests section.
gui.anomalyzone.pda.hb.x.quests_npc.intr: Scavengers around Valhalla hand out short quests, one per NPC. You can hold up to %1$s quests at once. An unaccepted offer lasts about %2$s min.
gui.anomalyzone.pda.hb.x.enemies_npc.int: Background scavengers around Valhalla do not fight: they stand at their posts and watch you. Some of them hand out quests or contracts — walk up and right-click.
gui.anomalyzone.pda.hb.x.lore_zone.intro: Nobody knows how it all began. Scavengers in Valhalla tell different tales, but agree on one thing: there was a day when the Zone first shuddered, and the world around never became the same. Since then time is counted from the Emissions.
gui.anomalyzone.pda.hb.x.lore_zone.tip: These are scavengers' tales, not an archive. Argue, check, but listen: they often hold more truth than reports.
